title: P2RLN QTI Profile
description: Carries version-declared QTI representations without redefining QTI semantics. QTI 3 is the preferred modern write target; legacy QTI discovered in older interchange packages may be preserved with its actual source version.
rules: Every QTI representation SHOULD declare its actual source/target QTI version in profile metadata when that version is known.
New interoperable QTI generated by a P2RLN qti.write implementation SHOULD target QTI 3 unless an explicit target requires an older version.
Legacy QTI 1.x/2.x payloads MAY be preserved and surfaced through this profile but MUST NOT be silently relabeled or converted to QTI 3.
P2RLN MUST NOT redefine QTI item, test, response-processing, scoring or accessibility semantics.
A processor without QTI semantic support MAY preserve the original QTI payload opaquely.
A processor claiming qti.read or qti.deliver MUST support the concrete QTI version/profile used by the selected representation.

bindings.version: legacy versions preservation-only unless explicitly converted
